# EventDrivenSpectralProcessing

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A processing paradigm where spectral computations are triggered only by spike events, avoiding continuous dense matrix operations. Reduces computational and energy costs on neuromorphic chips, making real-time multivariate forecasting feasible in edge deployments.
